def main():
    input_str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    count = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(input_str):
        run_length = 1
        while i + 1 < len(input_str) and input_str[i] == input_str[i + 1]:
            run_length += 1
            i += 1
        if run_length % 2 == 0:
            count += 1
        i += 1
    
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
